issues.span: When impatience, laziness, and fear appear, along with rudeness and idle talk. Or if a mind attached to my own side comes up
issues.evidence: Incomplete sentence: the first 'When...' clause is cut off, then 'Or if' starts again. Academic: one list (impatience, laziness, fear, impudence, idle chatter, or a mind attached to my own side), then 'at that time'.
issues.fix: If I feel impatience, laziness, fear, rudeness, or idle talk, or if my mind clings to my own side, then I should stay like a log.

issues.span: When I do things that are free of blame with myself and any living being
issues.evidence: Academic: blameless things are 'governed by myself and sentient beings' (they are under my and others' control). The children's text turns this into doing things together with living beings.
issues.fix: In things that are free of blame, which are in my hands and in the hands of living beings, I must always hold my mind like a magical creation, with no 'I' in it.

issues.span: You and the body are completely separate.
issues.evidence: Academic: 'If you and this are separate' - a conditional that sets up the question. The children's text states it as a flat fact.
issues.fix: If you and the body are separate, what can it really do for you?

issues.fix: So I will be in control of myself. I will always keep a smiling face... Be a friend to all beings who wander through life, and speak honestly.
